about_the_game:
"1960 e tal" is a puzzle game and a coming-of-age story, told on the same day each year as António packs his bags for summer vacation. Overcome challenging packing puzzles, as this dream-chasing story unravels, in a time of poverty and hard work.

Every puzzle solved reveals more of António's journey, from childhood innocence to the struggles of growing up. The objects you pack tell his story, shaping a narrative about aspirations, and the pursuit of a better future.

Features:

  • Packing-based puzzles that grow more complex each year

  • A narrative told across summers, blending gameplay and story

  • A heartfelt portrayal of 1970s Portugal and a life shaped by work, hope, and change

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 270X (2GB VRAM, DX11 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Not tested on these devices.

  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 590 (4-6 GB VRAM)
